title: Sample
description: One measured quantity at one instant. A max means the value is a proportion and can be a bar; a stream of samples over time is a series and can be a graph. The renderer chooses; the protocol does not.

key.description: Stable identifier, so a consumer can follow one quantity across frames even if its label changes.

value.description: Null when the reading was not finite: JSON has no NaN or infinity, and a frame that cannot be parsed is worse than a reading that is missing.

max.description: Full scale, when the quantity has one. Omitted means unbounded, which a bar cannot render and a graph can. Null when the scale itself was not finite.
